spoilerModel.recommendation: Secret layer off by default. Reveal hint, solution and contents only on explicit user action.

confidenceMeaning.confirmed: Strong source support such as wiki/achievement plus consistent walkthrough/community evidence.
confidenceMeaning.community-confirmed: Specific access method reported consistently by community sources.
confidenceMeaning.player-verified: Directly verified by the map owner/user in their gameplay; external evidence may support the broader mechanic.
confidenceMeaning.official-location-only: Developer patch notes confirm new hidden content at the POI, but the exact secret route is not sufficiently documented.

statusMeaning.accessible: Known intended access method is documented.
statusMeaning.details_incomplete: Secret content is known/officially confirmed at the POI, but the exact route or condition is not yet reliable enough.

secrets.name: Black Vein Station – secret camera room
secrets.hint: The entrance is well below the main station and above you once you swim into the concrete tower.
secrets.solution: Follow the concrete tower down roughly four-fifths of its height. Swim into the open section and look upward for a small square opening leading to the hidden room.

accessConditions.summary: Dive down the concrete tower and enter the square opening from below.

secrets.contentsSummary: A comparatively rich hidden room; community calls it the camera room.

secrets.name: Central Warehouse Alpha – hidden map room
secrets.hint: The secret is in the upper office. One storage unit has a handle that looks far more useful than the others.
secrets.solution: Gain access to the upper office and use the yellow/orange handle on the wall locker/shelving unit. The unit slides aside and reveals the hidden map room.

accessConditions.summary: Reach the security-gated upper office; community reports describe this as Security Clearance 3 / roughly character level 15.
Pull the yellow/orange handle on the wall storage unit.

secrets.contentsSummary: Hidden map room; discovering it completes The Warehouse quest and reveals the large-world map/lore scene.

secrets.name: Habitat Node 04-7 – Update 3.5 hidden additions
secrets.hint: Channel37 explicitly listed this POI among the locations receiving new rooms, caves, vents, secrets or hidden areas in Update 3.5.
secrets.solution: The available sources do not document the exact access route. This entry is listed as a research lead.
notes: Excluded from solved-secret progress because the entrance or access condition is not documented.

secrets.name: Habitat Node 05-14.5 – Update 3.5 hidden additions
secrets.hint: Channel37 explicitly listed this POI among the locations receiving new rooms, caves, vents, secrets or hidden areas in Update 3.5.
secrets.solution: The available sources do not document the exact access route. This entry is listed as a research lead.
notes: Excluded from solved-secret progress because the entrance or access condition is not documented.
Steam players reported two interesting underwater structures and a newly changed section just above the waterline, but exact intended secret routing remains incomplete.

secrets.hint: Channel37 explicitly listed this POI among the locations receiving new rooms, caves, vents, secrets or hidden areas in Update 3.5.
secrets.solution: The available sources do not document the exact access route. This entry is listed as a research lead.
notes: Excluded from solved-secret progress because the entrance or access condition is not documented.

secrets.name: Helios Reserve Lyra – 116 m power gate
secrets.hint: A second locked door lies much deeper in the same pool and follows the same power rule.
secrets.solution: Restore power at the main building, then reach the locked door around 116 m depth.

accessConditions.summary: Restore power at Helios Reserve Lyra main building.
Reach roughly 116 m depth.

secrets.name: Helios Reserve Lyra – 66 m power gate
secrets.hint: The locked door in the central pool is not a security-level puzzle; the facility needs its own power restored.
secrets.solution: Restore power at the main building, then return to the locked door around 66 m depth in the central pool.

accessConditions.summary: Restore power at Helios Reserve Lyra main building.

secrets.contentsSummary: Gated underwater area added in Update 4 beta/current content.

secrets.name: Nomads Tower – Update 3.5 secret area
secrets.hint: Channel37 explicitly listed this POI among the locations receiving new rooms, caves, vents, secrets or hidden areas in Update 3.5.
secrets.solution: The available sources do not document the exact access route. This entry is listed as a research lead.
notes: Excluded from solved-secret progress because the entrance or access condition is not documented.

secrets.name: Platform Omega – power-room side opening
secrets.hint: One new access point is not a door at all; it is a round opening on the side of the main power-room structure.
secrets.solution: Use the boat to reach the round opening on the side of the main power room. Community reports it as one of the new Update 3.5 access points.

accessConditions.summary: Position the boat to reach the round side opening.

secrets.name: Platform Omega – Tower 4 underwater lore room
secrets.hint: The inaccessible red lower doors are a distraction. Search outside and below Tower 4 instead.
secrets.solution: Dive outside below Tower 4. Community reports an underwater entrance/secret room there containing lore and tech.

accessConditions.summary: Search outside below Tower 4 / the bumped-out section.

notes: Do not mark the still-red underground Tower 1–4 doors themselves as solvable secrets; community reports they remained unavailable in the relevant build.

secrets.name: Quarantine Stack Amen – underground mine
secrets.hint: A previously secret section around the middle of the stack leads farther down after Update 3.5. Bring power and Big O2 bombs.
secrets.solution: Follow the hidden/secret route around the middle of Stack Amen to the new tunnel. Restore the required power from the upper stack, then use Big O2 bombs on obstructing rock where necessary; the tunnel descends into an underground mine.

accessConditions.summary: Restore power associated with the upper stack.
Bring Big/Large O2 explosives for rock obstructions.

secrets.name: Quarantine Stack Amen – vault behind boulders
secrets.hint: Inside the vault, a destroyed wall and suspicious boulders hide something green on the other side.
secrets.solution: Inside the vault, destroy the boulders at the broken wall. A Steam solution reports that two Large Oxygen Grenades were enough.

accessConditions.summary: Destroy the boulders; two Large Oxygen Grenades are reported sufficient.

secrets.contentsSummary: Hidden room with quantum crystals, a seated robot and a panel.

secrets.name: Quarantine Stack Chorus – underwater secret entrance
secrets.hint: The larger spire has an entrance below the surface on its north side.
secrets.solution: Search underwater on the north side of the larger Quarantine Stack Chorus spire for the hidden entrance.

accessConditions.summary: Dive on the north side of the larger spire.

secrets.name: Gamma – second underwater secret room
secrets.hint: The second door is not opened at the door itself. Search very high inside the first Tommy room and question what looks like an ordinary wall.
secrets.solution: Inside the Tommy room, get onto the pipes/upper edge above the entrance. A destructible false wall hides a button. Break/dismantle the false wall and use the hidden button to unlock the second underwater room.

accessConditions.summary: First gain access to the Tommy Room.
Reach the pipes/upper edge above the Tommy-room entrance.
Break/dismantle the false wall above the pipes.
Press the button behind the false wall.

secrets.name: Gamma – Tommy Room
secrets.hint: A toy associated with the giant dinosaur head is the key.
secrets.solution: Dive beneath the outpost, enter the square underwater duct and reach the locked room. Carry Tommy the T-Rex toy in your inventory to open the first hidden room.

accessConditions.summary: Enter through the square underwater duct.
Carry Tommy the T-Rex toy.

secrets.contentsSummary: Large hidden room with loot, lore and sample 127 'Smile in the Dark'.

secrets.name: Refuel Outpost Theta – hidden oil room
secrets.hint: Swim beneath the platform and look upward. Bring a long fuel cable and be ready for a crowded room.
secrets.solution: Dive beneath Refuel Outpost Theta and search upward for the hidden access. Community reports describe a room packed with green crawlers and about 16,000 L of oil, plus memories and scrap.

accessConditions.summary: Swim below the station and locate the upward access.
Prepare for many green crawler enemies.
A long fuel-cable route is useful to extract the oil.

secrets.contentsSummary: Reported ~16,000 L oil, Memories and scrap.
knownIssues: Community specifically warns against grenades/flamethrower around the oil room.

secrets.name: Mother Under the Sea
secrets.hint: Close to where you first woke, one of the building's pipes continues far deeper than normal exploration suggests.
secrets.solution: Facing Sanctuary Dock 37's large main door from outside, follow the pipe attached to the building on the left down to roughly 200 m. The hidden Mother statue is at the bottom area; approaching it triggers the achievement.

accessConditions.summary: Descend to roughly 200 m; high Pressure enhancement is required.
Follow the pipe left of the Sanctuary's large main door.

secrets.contentsSummary: Hidden Mother statue and Steam achievement 'Mother Under the Sea'.
knownIssues: The upper pipe section contains an accessible dead-end with scrap/memories; a different above-water curved section is not intended normal access.

secrets.name: Sanctuary Dock 37 – ceiling catwalks
secrets.hint: Look high above the basin near the facility-power balcony. Hazard paint marks a route that is easy to dismiss as scenery.
secrets.solution: Go to the balcony with the main facility power switch. Facing the switch, turn right and look up for the black/yellow hazard-painted ledge. Jump from the railing onto it. Midway along the catwalk, remove two vent covers and cross to the opposite catwalk.

accessConditions.summary: Jump from the power-switch balcony railing to the hazard-painted ledge.
Remove two vent covers on the catwalk.

secrets.name: Sanctuary Dock 37 – outside-access grate loot
secrets.hint: You can see this loot through a grate from the main floor, but the route does not start inside.
secrets.solution: Approach from outside the Sanctuary. Community guidance describes a round open pipe and a torn grate as access points to hidden loot areas visible from inside.

accessConditions.summary: Reach the hidden area from outside via the open pipe / torn grate.

notes: Room 997, separately visible on PECO footage, was still reported as inaccessible; do not merge it with this accessible loot area.

secrets.name: Seed Vault Prometheus – submerged seed-room secret
secrets.hint: The secret is beneath the area where the human seeds are stored. One of the foundation posts is hollow enough to matter.
secrets.solution: Search underwater beneath the seed area. Community reports identify the far-right post/foundation when facing the main entrance as the route into a hidden room below the seed rooms.

accessConditions.summary: Enter through the far-right foundation/post beneath the seed area.

secrets.name: The Fourth Chamber – statue vault
secrets.hint: Three scanned statues must be reconstructed in a specific historical order before the powered door will cooperate.
secrets.solution: At the hidden cave around 109:-34 (community thread uses 108:-34), place the replicated statues left-to-right as Augustus of Prima Porta, Moses, then Vulcan, God of the Forge. Connect power to open the locked door.

accessConditions.summary: Replicate and place three scanned statues.
Left-to-right: Augustus of Prima Porta → Moses → Vulcan, God of the Forge.
Connect power after the statues are correctly placed.

secrets.contentsSummary: Additional loot, QR-code message and access to the inner chamber; the cave also contains four painting samples.
notes: Coordinate difference is only 1 map unit: current Wiki locations table says 109:-34; Steam sample thread says 108:-34.

secrets.name: Last Listener – submerged foundation room
secrets.hint: The smaller foundation that carries the extendable bridge has more beneath it than the quest requires.
secrets.solution: At the smaller of the two base platforms, where the bridge extends, dive beneath the concrete foundation. A hole underneath leads to a hidden room.

accessConditions.summary: Dive beneath the smaller bridge-extension foundation.

secrets.contentsSummary: Hidden papers/lore and loot; not required for the main quest.

secrets.name: Secret of the Maze
secrets.hint: Three ordinary-looking objects in three numbered rooms control the hidden room. The three green indicators in room 037 show your progress.
secrets.solution: Activate the clock in the second room 090, the painting in room 026, and the hidden button behind boxes in room 034. The hidden room is associated with room 037 and the Steam achievement 'Secret of the Maze'.

accessConditions.summary: Activate clock in the second room 090.
Activate painting in room 026.
Activate hidden button behind boxes in room 034.

secrets.contentsSummary: Hidden room / achievement: Secret of the Maze.
knownIssues: Players report cases where all three lights are green but the secret door remains closed.
The trigger objects can become non-interactive, making recovery difficult; save/reload does not always fix it.

secrets.name: Transposium – Teddy theater passage
secrets.hint: The theater passage reacts to where the teddy bears are left. Carrying one through the door is part of the problem rather than the solution.
secrets.solution: Remove the teddy bears from the theater, place them in the caretaker-bot room, and approach the passage without a Teddy Bear in your inventory. Once the theater is clear, the next door stays open.

accessConditions.summary: No Teddy Bear in inventory.
Remove all spawned Teddy Bears from the theater room.

knownIssues: Some players report teddy/door sequences failing to spawn or update correctly after saves; reloads may be required.
notes: This consolidates the former no-Teddy inventory door and Teddy theater passage records because they describe the same door.
The negative inventory condition is player-verified.

secrets.name: Transposium – Teddy-required door
secrets.hint: A comfort object shown in the evacuation imagery matters to this door.
secrets.solution: Carry a Teddy Bear when approaching the relevant door. A Steam discussion explicitly describes a Transposium door that only opens with a teddy.

accessConditions.summary: Teddy Bear must be carried.

notes: Do not conflate this Teddy-required door with the separate Teddy theater passage.
